record.definition: unit-size-adjusted median resale $psf, Sep 2021–Sep 2023 against Oct 2024–Sep 2026

text.price: $1,515 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 19.
text.record: Prices rose 22% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 21% for developments with similar features in District 19 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Buangkok MRT, about 260 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
supply: Land sold for about 830 new homes within 2 km.
text.demand: 45 resales in the last 24 months, in 21 of 24 months.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 19.
